title: 🕵️ Детектор ошибок: Present Simple
description: В предложениях спрятаны ошибки. Кликни на неверное слово. Если ошибки нет — нажми «Всё верно!».

items.text: She don't believe in bad luck.
My family go to the festival every year.
We makes decorations for the celebration.
He carry a lucky coin in his pocket.
Our town organise concerts in the square.
I wears special clothes on holidays.
The ceremony don't begin until noon.
My family celebrates Easter at home every year.
